mapper.sql: a.id, a.account_id, a.bank_account_number, b.pin_hash, a.cash_balance, b.balance AS bank_balance, a.currency, b.currency AS bank_currency, a.status, a.version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM Accounts a JOIN Third_Party_Bank b ON b.bank_account_number = a.bank_account_number JOIN Users u ON u.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND lower(b.email) = lower(u.email)

SELECT FROM Accounts a JOIN Third_Party_Bank b ON b.bank_account_number = a.bank_account_number JOIN Users u ON u.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND lower(b.email) = lower(u.email) FOR UPDATE OF a, b
mapper.update: UPDATE Third_Party_Bank SET balance = balance - #{amount} WHERE bank_account_number = #{bankAccountNumber} AND balance >= #{amount}
UPDATE Third_Party_Bank SET balance = balance + #{amount} WHERE bank_account_number = #{bankAccountNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Transactions (account_id, transaction_type, amount, metadata, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{accountUuid}, CAST(#{type} AS transaction_type_enum), #{amount}, jsonb_build_object('source', 'linked_bank'), #{idempotencyKey}::text)
mapper.select: SELECT o.limit_price, o.quantity - COALESCE(o.filled_quantity, 0) AS remaining_quantity, COALESCE(o.fee_rate, 0) AS fee_rate, i.currency AS instrument_currency FROM Orders o JOIN Instruments i ON i.instrument_id = o.instrument_id WHERE o.account_id = #{accountUuid} AND o.side = 'BUY'::order_side_enum AND o.status IN ('NEW'::order_status_enum, 'PARTIALLY_FILLED'::order_status_enum) AND o.limit_price IS NOT NULL

SELECT t.transaction_id, t.transaction_type::text AS transaction_type, t.amount, a.currency, t.transaction_date FROM Transactions t JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC, t.transaction_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Transactions t JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.id = #{accountId}
